body.statement: At \(q^0\), the residual mean tilt in each \((a,x)\) cell is Fisher-orthogonal to every zero-mean shape tangent, the efficient cell-mean information under design \(r\) is \(I_r\), and the least-favorable lift \(T_r\) satisfies \(A_{\mathrm{map}}T_r=I_d\) and \(T_r^\top I_rT_r=\Sigma(r)^{-1}\).
body.justification: The identities expose the exact covariance of the efficient policy-contrast signal after selective annotation.
body.gap: Levis et al. give general observed-data influence-function projection, but not this full saturated tangent decomposition or overlapping-policy covariance identity.
body.consumer: The lemma supplies the least-favorable slice and the covariance input for both the Gaussian game and the AIPW estimator.
body.proof_tex:
For a fixed cell \(c=(a,x)\), define
\[
m_{c\ell}=\frac{q^0_{c\ell}(y_\ell-\mu_c(q^0))}{\sigma_c^2(q^0)}.
\]
As \(\sum_\ell m_{c\ell}=0\) and \(\sum_\ell y_\ell m_{c\ell}=1\), every simplex tangent \(s_c\) has the unique decomposition
\[
s_c=b_cm_c+k_c,\qquad b_c=\sum_\ell y_\ell s_{c\ell},\qquad
\sum_\ell k_{c\ell}=\sum_\ell y_\ell k_{c\ell}=0.
\]
Under the multinomial Fisher inner product,
\[
\sum_\ell\frac{m_{c\ell}k_{c\ell}}{q^0_{c\ell}}
=\frac{1}{\sigma_c^2(q^0)}\sum_\ell(y_\ell-\mu_c(q^0))k_{c\ell}=0,
\qquad
\sum_\ell\frac{m_{c\ell}^2}{q^0_{c\ell}}=\frac{1}{\sigma_c^2(q^0)}.
\]
Annotation ignorability makes an observed label in cell \(c\) occur with probability \(p_xe_{ax}r_{ax}\), while an unlabelled record has zero outcome score. Hence the residual mean tangent is Fisher-orthogonal to every shape tangent and its information is \(p_xe_{ax}r_{ax}/\sigma_c^2(q^0)\), exactly the corresponding diagonal entry of \(I_r\).

All entries of \(I_r\) are positive: \(p_x,e_{ax},r_{ax}>0\), and eta positivity on a support with distinct values makes \(\sigma_c^2(q^0)>0\). Direct block multiplication yields
\[
A_{\mathrm{map}}I_r^{-1}A_{\mathrm{map}}^\top
=\sum_{x=1}^K\sum_{a=0}^1
\frac{p_x\sigma^2_{ax}(q^0)}{e_{ax}r_{ax}}d_xd_x^\top
=\Sigma(r).
\]
Since \(A_{\mathrm{map}}\) has row rank \(d\), this matrix is positive definite. Substitution of \(T_r=I_r^{-1}A_{\mathrm{map}}^\top\Sigma(r)^{-1}\) now gives
\[
A_{\mathrm{map}}T_r
=A_{\mathrm{map}}I_r^{-1}A_{\mathrm{map}}^\top\Sigma(r)^{-1}=I_d,
\]
and
\[
T_r^\top I_rT_r
=\Sigma(r)^{-1}A_{\mathrm{map}}I_r^{-1}A_{\mathrm{map}}^\top\Sigma(r)^{-1}
=\Sigma(r)^{-1}.
\]
This also proves that the probability lift \(\mathcal T_r\) has contrast \(A_{\mathrm{tan}}\mathcal T_rb=b\) and information \(J_r(\mathcal T_rb,\mathcal T_rc)=b^\top\Sigma(r)^{-1}c\).
